  - banner:
    - link "Potrero":
      - /url: /

      - /url: /
      - text: Live football
    - button "Español"
    - button "Português"
    - button "English" [pressed]
    - button "Français"
    - button "Italiano"

      - img

      - img
  - main:
    - link "El Ídolo":
      - /url: /el-idolo
      - heading "El Ídolo" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Training ground
    - paragraph: Difficulty
    - button "Easy 99-rated player, gentle rules" [pressed]:
      - img
      - text: Easy 99-rated player, gentle rules
    - button "Normal 80-rated player, career rules"
    - button "Hard 60-rated player, small club and small nation"
    - paragraph: The bars mark the games that change with difficulty. The rest are always the same, in a career too.
    - text: 🧠
    - heading "Skill games" [level=2]
    - text: "19"
    - paragraph: ⚽ Striker and playmaker
    - button "The manager's board Memorize the set plays and match the pairs. ›"
    - button "The solo run Cut between lanes and survive the whole run. ›"
    - button "The run Stop the bar right on the sweet spot. ›"
    - 'button "Tic-tac-toe The training-ground play: four in a row. ›"'
    - button "The ball boys Follow the ball through the quick-throw shuffle. ›"
    - 'button "The Code The set-piece call: memorize the digits and punch them in. ›"'
    - 'button "The through ball The skilled player’s Intercontinental: release the pass when the gap between defenders opens. ›"'
    - 'button "The rondo The skilled player’s youth final: tap the free teammate before he gets closed down. ›"'
    - paragraph: 🧤 Goalkeeper
    - 'button "The Flight Eight shots on goal: touch the ball before it crosses the line. ›"'
    - button "The Three Posts Nine shots at three zones. One pardon only. ›"
    - button "The Deflection Tap the post the shot is heading to and correct if it clips a defender. ›"
    - button "The Marking Memorize the corner danger order and mark 1 through 6. ›"
    - button "Playing Out Drag your finger through the build-up without touching rivals. ›"
    - 'button "The long throw The goalkeeper’s Intercontinental: throw long when your striker gets free of the press. ›"'
    - 'button "Playing out under pressure The skilled goalkeeper’s youth final: play it out by tapping the free teammate. ›"'
    - paragraph: 🏆 World Cup modes
    - button "The manager's signal Memorize the sequence and repeat it clean. ›"
    - button "Down to the wire Stop the pointer at the exact moment. ›"
    - 'button "Beat the keeper The keeper sweeps the goal: tap the open gap. ›"'
    - button "The Gap The opponents cover the whole front except one gap. You see it for an instant, it gets covered, you mark where it was. ›"
    - text: 🎲
    - heading "Gut-feeling games" [level=2]
    - text: "14"
    - paragraph: ⚽ Striker and playmaker
    - button "The Loose Ball Pick the gap you send it through and watch it bounce down to the line. Pure faith. ›"
    - 'button "The dice game The superstitious player’s youth final: five dice, three rolls, keep the ones you want. ›"'
    - 'button "The Hunch Higher or lower, cards 1 to 12: three in a row and the final is yours. ›"'
    - button "The thunderbolt Charge the shot and release when it feels right. ›"
    - 'button "The street wheel Four plays for the goal: load power, release, let the wheel decide. ›"'
    - button "The intercontinental grid Uncover the hidden goals before you run out of picks. ›"
    - paragraph: 🧤 Goalkeeper
    - 'button "The Step Out He is through on goal: step out to cut the angle, or hold. Every step covers more goal... and more risk. ›"'
    - button "The Ritual Three rituals out of six. Two are lucky and nobody knows which. Pure faith. ›"
    - 'button "The Dive Here comes the shot for the title: pick which way you dive. ›"'
    - button "The Loose Ball You clear it and it comes back. Pick where you shove it and pray it hits someone. ›"
    - button "The Studs Rain or shine? Pick your boots the night before. ›"
    - 'button "The Tower The bracket as a tower: each round you pick how you stop it, and one has been scouted. ›"'
    - paragraph: 🏆 World Cup modes
    - 'button "The Tower The bracket as a tower: every round you pick a play, and one of them they have studied. ›"'
    - 'button "The World Cup grid The classic: flip the cells and ride your luck. ›"'
    - link "← Back to El Ídolo":
      - /url: /el-idolo
  - contentinfo:
    - paragraph: POTRERO
    - paragraph: Datos. Pasión. Fútbol.
    - navigation "Enlaces del sitio":
      - link "About Potrero":
        - /url: /sobre-potrero

        - /url: /el-idolo/guia

      - link "Terms":
        - /url: /terminos
      - link "Advertising":
        - /url: /publicidad
      - link "Contact":
        - /url: /contacto

      - /url: https://argfutquiz.app

limitations: Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
